Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N and Q followed by N numbers. Now Q inputs of 2 Numbers U and V are given. U indicates the starting index and V indicates the ending index. So for each U,V find the XOR of all values of the array from the index U to V (1 based indexing). HINT : USE SEGMENT TREE 
Input Description:
The input consists of 2 numbers N and Q, followed by N numbers. Then Q inputs of 2 numbers U and V are given, where U indicates the starting index and V indicates the ending index. Input Size : N<=100000 
Output Description:
For each query (U,V), output the XOR sum of all values in the array from index U to V (1-based indexing). 
Sample Input:
5 3
1 2 1 4 1
1 3
2 4
3 4 
Sample Output:
2
7
5
